spans.s:
लुब्(इ)लुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लुम्बति लुम्बयति-ते) To hurt, to pain, to
afflict or torment. r. 10th cl. (लुम्बयति) To disappear.

लुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Covetous, greedy, desirous, cupidinous.
 m. (-ब्धः)
1. A hunter.
 2. A lecher, a libertine.
 E. लुभ् to desire, to wish for
vehemently, to covet, aff. क्त ।

लुब्धक m. (-कः)
 1. A hunter.
 2. A libertine, a rake, a whore-monger.
 3.
A covetous or greedy man.
 4. The star

. A tiger.
 E. लुब्ध
desirous, aff. कन् ।
